name: Q55: compact icosahedral polar-truncation Coxeter 5-polytope
description: A compact hyperbolic Coxeter 5-polytope with 55 facets.  It is the complete polar truncation of a 15-wall H3 x A1-symmetric hyperideal configuration built from a regular icosahedron.
notes: Pair counts: 315 right-angle pairs, 12 pi/3 pairs, 2 pi/5 pairs, and 1156 ultraparallel pairs.
Publication-level novelty has not been established.
The Coxeter matrix is isomorphic to the kernel of the retraction W(G12221) -> W(H3 x A1), recomputed from the certified G12221 Gram data (scripts/compact5d/make_g12221_unfoldings.py).
Further fibering work on this example is in progress and not yet published.

sourceRefs.citation: Pavel Tumarkin, Compact Hyperbolic Coxeter n-Polytopes with n+3 Facets, Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 14 (2007), R69.
sourceRefs.notes: Source polytope; the unfolding is a reflection subgroup of its Coxeter group.

sourceRefs.citation: Michael W. Davis, The Geometry and Topology of Coxeter Groups, Princeton University Press, 2008.
sourceRefs.locator: Special subgroups and retractions onto them
sourceRefs.notes: A retraction onto a finite special subgroup has a reflection-group kernel with fundamental domain the union of the chambers around the corresponding face.

warnings: The 3D projection is a drawing convention and does not certify hyperbolic distances or intersections.
